registryNote: Resources, collections and scenes are entered as JSON while there is no builder UI. Every declaration is validated on start; anything rejected is logged with a reason and skipped, and the rest still runs.
resourcesHelp: Each resource declares an owner adapter instance and its capabilities. The states named here are the only states this adapter will ever touch.
collectionsHelp: Members discovered at runtime by object pattern, such as Blustream transmitters or ATEM inputs.
scenesHelp: Sequences of actions, delays and waits. Validated on start: unknown actions, unknown scenes and scene cycles are rejected before anything runs.
